text:
maria_devex: heads-up — got a customer report that our python async client sometimes re-sends POST bodies after a timeout, causing duplicate orders. they hit it on 1.12.3. link to minimal repro in thread below. @lee_py_sdk can you take a look?

lee_py_sdk: repro confirmed. quick snippet i used:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
import asyncio

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key=... , timeout=2)
    await c.post('/v1/orders', json={'item': 't-shirt'})

asyncio.run(main())
```
behavior: request times out (asyncio.TimeoutError) and our internal retry loop attempts a resend even though method is POST and no idempotency header passed. stack: TimeoutError -> _handle_retry -> send_request again. i've attached the exception/log lines in the repro gist.

sam_runtime: oy. that is bad. our intended policy was: only auto-retry non-GET if an idempotency key is present or method is idempotent. looks like the check for "can_retry_body" is flawed — it tests for hasattr(body, 'seek') and falls back to True for small bodies. streaming bodies trigger the fallback.

alyssa_sre: customer impact: duplicate charges/orders. recommend immediate mitigation: ship a patch that disables automatic retries for POST/PUT/PATCH unless explicit idempotency-key header is provided. that reduces outage blast radius.

lee_py_sdk: agreed. quick suggestion for fix:
- change default retry policy: if method in (POST,PUT,PATCH) and no Idempotency-Key -> do not retry on timeout/5xx.
- introduce explicit opt-in param `allow_replay_nonidempotent=True` (False by default).
- when bodies are streams, preserve ability to retry only if the body is buffered internally (we can cap to 1MB).

sam_runtime: also add jittered exponential backoff and make the retryable status codes explicit: 429, 502, 503, 504. we should not auto-retry on 500 unless a special flag is set.

maria_devex: can we also add telemetry: emit a metric `sdk.request.replayed` with tags method=/path and customer_id so we can find damage?

lee_py_sdk: yes. i'll add two counters: replay_attempt and replay_blocked (blocked meaning we detected non-idempotent and prevented retry).

ops_bot: issue-tracker: Created ticket #4567 "py-sdk: prevent silent replay of non-idempotent requests after timeout" and linked reproduction gist https://gist.github.com/XXX

sam_runtime: unit tests to add:
- POST without idempotency-key times out -> no retry and surface TimeoutError to caller.
- POST with idempotency-key retries up to N with exponential backoff.
- streaming body > buffer_limit -> no retry unless user enabled buffering.
- preserved headers: Idempotency-Key should be forwarded on retry.

lee_py_sdk: small PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/789 — changes default policy and adds metrics + tests. folks, can you review? quick notes in PR about behavior change and migration guidance: set idempotency_key via client.post(..., idempotency_key=...) or pass headers {"Idempotency-Key": "..."}. example:
```python
await client.post('/v1/orders', json=payload, idempotency_key='order-1234')
```

maria_devex: review done. leaving an inline comment asking to add deprecation note in changelog for 1.12.x -> 1.13.0 since retry semantics changed. also add a snippet in docs/faq about duplicate requests and how to opt-in.

alyssa_sre: approved. for emergency hotfix we should also cut a 1.12.4 that toggles off non-idempotent retries only for hosted customers (feature-flag) so on-prem customers unaffected until they upgrade. can ops add the flag?

ops_bot: infra: feature-flag `sdk.enforce_idempotency_retries` set to true on hosted by default.

lee_py_sdk: pushed patch with tests and added buffering logic with a cap of 1MB. if user body >1MB and they want retries, they must set `buffer_retries=True` or provide an idempotency key. i'll merge once CI green.

maria_devex: thanks all. can someone follow up with the customer and confirm mitigation (turned on flag + new SDK patch recommended)? i'll draft the customer note. :pray:

sam_runtime: i'll take that. will also add a changelog entry about default max_retries reduced for non-idempotent methods.

lee_py_sdk: CI green, merged. closing ticket after monitoring metrics for 48h.

maria_devex: perfect. thanks team :tada:
